sentences.text: What does a determinant actually do? {shows}Watch the unit square{applies} as a matrix acts on the plane.
sentences.spoken: What does a determinant actually do? Watch the unit square as a matrix acts on the plane.

sentences.text: For a two by two matrix, the determinant is ad minus bc.
sentences.spoken: For a two by two matrix, the determinant is ad minus bc.

sentences.text: Here: three times two, minus one times one. {lands}Five.
sentences.spoken: Here: three times two, minus one times one. Five.

sentences.text: If we swap the two columns, the determinant becomes one minus six, which is minus five, so the plane {flips}flips its orientation.
sentences.spoken: If we swap the two columns, the determinant becomes one minus six, which is minus five, so the plane flips its orientation.

sentences.text: The eigenvalues satisfy lambda squared minus five lambda plus six equals zero, so lambda is two or three.
sentences.spoken: The eigenvalues satisfy lambda squared minus five lambda plus six equals zero, so lambda is two or three.

sentences.text: A determinant is the area scale factor. Five means five times the area.
sentences.spoken: A determinant is the area scale factor. Five means five times the area.

sentences.text: Each eigenvector keeps its direction and is only stretched by its eigenvalue.
sentences.spoken: Each eigenvector keeps its direction and is only stretched by its eigenvalue.

sentences.text: The sum of the first n odd numbers is exactly n squared, and you can see it by wrapping L shapes around a growing square.
